_doc: What kind of item a message is, from protocol data only (never its words): Outlook/MAPI message classes by prefix (MS-OXOCAL, MS-OXOMSG, MS-OXOOOF), then RFC headers: Content-Type multipart/report report-type (RFC 6522: delivery-status RFC 3464, disposition-notification RFC 8098), text/calendar METHOD (RFC 5546), Auto-Submitted (RFC 3834). The longest matching class prefix wins; matching is case-insensitive. Anything else is an ordinary message. Non-ordinary items never count as replies or as mail waiting for one.

automated._doc: Machine-sent mail (mail.Automated), from transport headers only: List-Id (RFC 2919) and List-Unsubscribe (RFC 2369) by presence; Precedence bulk/list/junk (de facto, RFC 3834 §3.1.8 notes it); any Auto-Submitted keyword except no (RFC 3834 §5).
